tools.name: search_records_by_name
tools.description: Resolve a name to a candidate, job, application or email template.

tools.name: filter_records
tools.description: Find or count candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, openings, scheduled interviews or offers by criteria. Costs 2 rate-limit units.

tools.name: describe_object_fields
tools.description: Helper: the filterable fields of a record type, before filter_records.

tools.name: get_record_details
tools.description: Full details of located jobs, job postings, applications, email templates, openings, scheduled interviews or offers.

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.description: A candidate's profile: resume, interview feedback, emails, texts, notes, interview transcripts, referrals, follow-ups, form submissions.

tools.name: list_interviews
tools.description: Search the current Ashby user's interviews by candidate name and/or date range. The window defaults to the past 7 days through the next 7 days, so both recent and upcoming interviews are included.

tools.name: get_interview_details
tools.description: Prep briefing for one interview: candidate background, resume summary, panel, hiring team.

tools.name: get_interview_plan
tools.description: The stages of a job's or application's interview plan.

tools.name: get_submitted_feedback
tools.description: Scorecard feedback the user personally submitted, never other interviewers'.

tools.name: get_job_pipeline
tools.description: Candidate counts per stage for one or more jobs.

tools.name: get_pending_tasks
tools.description: The user's pending tasks: scorecards owed, approvals, follow-ups, candidate reviews, survey requests.

tools.name: search_product_docs
tools.description: Answers 'how do I' questions from Ashby's product docs, with links.

tools.name: create_candidate
tools.description: Create a candidate with name and contact details.

tools.name: add_note_to_candidate
tools.description: Draft a note on a candidate's profile for the user to confirm before saving; can reply to a note.

tools.name: consider_candidate_for_job
tools.description: Create an application for a candidate at the first stage of a job's interview plan.

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Move an application to another stage, including Archived (needs an archive reason; the stage's automatic activities run, such as an automated archive email to the candidate).

tools.name: submit_mcp_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback to the Ashby team when the server hits a limitation.
